title: Bonsai 2 27B: Near-Lossless Compression in a 9x Smaller Footprint
summary: Bonsai 2 27B is a model compression technique that reduces a 27-billion-parameter model to roughly 9x smaller size while maintaining near-lossless quality. The linked article and Hacker News discussion (475 points, 141 comments) cover the method, tradeoffs, and practical implications for running large models with reduced memory and compute requirements.
